## Architecture Overview

The `Histogram` struct is defined in `prometheus/model/histogram/histogram.go` with fields: CounterResetHint, Schema, ZeroThreshold, ZeroCount, Count, Sum, PositiveSpans, NegativeSpans, PositiveBuckets, NegativeBuckets, CustomValues. Adding `CreatedTimestamp int64` breaks all struct literal constructions.
